items.title: User input entering an explicit Plan state machine

userPath.entrypoint: Send a normal chat message
userPath.boundary: Plan mode affects permissions; it does not create a complete editable plan workflow.

knownExclusions: No verified standalone editable Plan state machine for ordinary Chat.
Plan/read-only should not be described as full plan orchestration.

items.title: Automatic decomposition and multi-role assignment

userPath.entrypoint: Use explicit orchestration or Task Loop entrypoints
userPath.boundary: Ordinary Chat is not forced through multi-role orchestration.

knownExclusions: No claim that simple Chat always invokes multiple role workers.
No default automatic role assignment guarantee for all prompts.

items.title: Workspace automatically creates projects, installs dependencies, and executes

userPath.entrypoint: Agent tool use with workspace permissions
userPath.boundary: Automation depends on tool calls and permissions; there is no single guaranteed project bootstrap flow.

knownExclusions: No guarantee that every task installs dependencies automatically.
No guarantee that workspace bootstrap succeeds without explicit tool execution.

items.title: Trace and event graph existence

userPath.entrypoint: Query traces by runId, sessionKey, or workspace
userPath.boundary: The source exists, but real runtime queryability failed in the latest validation.

items.title: Work panel displays plan or execution graph with status updates

items.title: Completion writes final assistant message and completion state

knownExclusions: No guarantee that chat.history is immediately readable during Gateway startup.

items.title: Editable Chat task DAG

userPath.boundary: Chat does not expose editable DAG dependency controls.

knownExclusions: Chat does not expose editable DAG add/remove edge controls.

items.title: Confirmed plan persists and can be restored

userPath.entrypoint: Run an explicit long task or loop
userPath.boundary: Ordinary Chat plan persistence as editable DAG is not proven.

knownExclusions: No editable Chat DAG restore guarantee.
No claim that every displayed Chat plan is durable workflow state.

items.title: Plan stage supports structured diff and incremental editing

userPath.entrypoint: Guide, queue, interrupt, or revise a long task
userPath.boundary: These controls are not a general Chat plan diff editor.

items.title: Built-in roles and responsibilities exist

items.title: User custom or temporary roles exist

items.title: Electron starts and manages Gateway

userPath.entrypoint: Launch the Electron app
userPath.boundary: Startup readiness is not evidence for unrelated advanced claims.

items.title: Avoid Workspace and Runtime dependency cycles

userPath.entrypoint: Use host API mediated calls

items.title: Communication is async JSON-RPC with timeout

items.title: Global idempotency strategy

userPath.entrypoint: Use checkpoint or intervention flows

No global filesystem mutation idempotency guarantee.

items.title: User intervention during long tasks

userPath.boundary: The claim is scoped to explicit long-task or Task Loop contexts.

knownExclusions: No claim that every ordinary Chat request is interruptible through long-task semantics.

items.title: Checkpoint stores full context and file snapshot

userPath.entrypoint: Resume from checkpoint or inspect recovery context

knownExclusions: No unified tool-count limit product proof.

userPath.boundary: Thresholds are not lossless guarantees.

items.title: Observability and Memory sensitive content protection

userPath.entrypoint: Record traces or propose memory entries
userPath.boundary: Protection is local to these systems and does not cover the full chain.

knownExclusions: No full-chain secret-free guarantee.

items.title: Explicit long-session coordinator keeps one durable piece of work across configured lifecycle actions

userPath.surface: Chat activity rail (explicitly bound coordinator session)
userPath.entrypoint: Bind a coordinator session, send work, restart, and follow the completion batch
userPath.boundary: Ordinary Chat is not auto-promoted; the C4 rail requires an explicit binding and the task facts stay in Task Ledger.

knownExclusions: No live-provider or native-backend thread continuity claim: no authorized provider credential was available.
No asynchronous compression promotion: D2/D3 stayed EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT and keep-baseline.

No real-human long-term use: every artifact is agent-driven and the fixture is synthetic; nothing here is human-usage evidence.
